name: Arsenic Trioxide

own_problems.text: Carries a boxed warning in United States — for cancer risk and heart harm

fda.text: For oral use only. Chronically enlarged lymph nodes can be the sign of different diseases. Therefore, consult a doctor in order to clarify the underlying disease before using this medicine. Also consult a doctor promptly in case of acute signs of inflammation (redness, heat, swelling, pain and dysfunction) and fever…

summary: In the United States, Arsenic Trioxide carries a boxed warning, which is the strictest type of safety warning, for heart harm and carcinogenicity (the ability to cause cancer) [3]. According to a small computer model rather than tests on people, the drug received low risk scores of 17 for liver harm and 10 for heart harm [M]. An official drug label warns that this medicine is for oral use only and advises consulting a doctor for chronically enlarged lymph nodes, fever, or acute signs of inflammation such as redness, heat, swelling, pain, and dysfunction [4].
